invariants.statement: WHEN a subagent dispatch carries a resolved permission ruleset, THE SYSTEM SHALL classify the lane from that ruleset (producer iff it can edit or run bash; read-only iff both are catch-all denied), and WHEN no ruleset is given, THE SYSTEM SHALL fall back to the lane name
invariants.property: forall ruleset r: (can_edit(r) or can_bash(r)) => producer(r)
